profiler_shutdown_note: The local profiler writes at shutdown priority 10. WC_Session_Handler and StoreApi\\SessionHandler save session data at shutdown priority 20, so post-request session row snapshots are authoritative for saved session state while profiler query digests can miss the final session save query.
finding: Tokenized Store API cart requests use Automattic\\WooCommerce\\StoreApi\\SessionHandler and read wp_woocommerce_sessions directly on each request with a valid Cart-Token. Empty initial carts do not create a row, add-item creates the row, and removing the last item leaves a session row containing removed_cart_contents/other residual session data rather than using the regular frontend destroy-empty-sessions cleanup path. Source audit confirms removed_cart_contents supports undo behavior and is normally cleared by WC_Cart_Session::clean_up_removed_cart_contents() on a later frontend page request, not by the Store API remove-item route itself.
